entries.text: That's entertainment! We came, we saw, we conquered. And if the taste of victory is sweet, the taste of virtual victory is not sweet 'n low, nor the bullets made of sugar. Maybe out past where the imagination ends, our true natures lie, waiting to be confronted on their own terms. Out where the intellect is at war with the primitive brain... In the hostile territory of the digital world... Where laws are silent and rules disappear in the midst of arms.
